voltage_levels.reference: Article 3: third category above 1 kV up to 30 kV, second above 30 kV up to 66 kV, first above 66 kV and below 220 kV, special from 220 kV (and lower lines of the transmission grid); a line above 400 kV needs the voltage set by the administration. Low voltage is everything up to 1 kV. A line of exactly 220 kV is of the special category, where these levels, which include their upper bound, read the first. The decree was published on 19 March 2008 and entered into force six months later (final provision three)
